rv.q: The first 20 minutes of Samuel Beckett's merciless, miniature masterpiece is almost complete silence, but there is no lack of eloquence in the performance of Michael Gambon...
But this ain’t good enough, and certainly no challenge to the greatest Krapps I’ve seen...

cn.t: Critics split on this production: one praises the haunting visual staging and atmosphere, while another finds it underwhelming and poorly paced, with logistical issues detracting from Gambon's performance.
